· SMA100/200($291.10/$274.26) position: Mixed long-term trend, support confirmed above SMA200.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (36.9→34.6): Entering oversold territory, downtrend continues.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-1.0712→-0.5908): Improving, signaling weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $279.35): Approaching lower band, band width narrowing at 6.71%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($281.03): Based on lower Bollinger Band and Pivot S1($273.68).
· Swing Resistance ($287.58): Based on Pivot PP($287.03) and SMA5, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High / Higher Low not formed): Sideways range continues.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.12x): Normal level, moderate confidence in movement.
· Current Range Diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Consider buying on RSI oversold exit and approach to lower Bollinger Band, wait-and-see on resistance breakout.
